objective: Verify the three main theorems of arXiv:1606.07052v1 in the existing private diss-lean worktree and branch.

requirements.requirement: Every main theorem has a precise statement matching the pinned source domains, hypotheses, quantifiers, topology and normalization.
requirements.detail: Theorem 1.1 quantifies over every finite p>2, all original real scalar inputs, every smooth real initial-data sequence, one open local neighborhood and positive common time, and one invariant open zero neighborhood before all T>0. Its global clause explicitly supplies the single continuous all-real-time flow and approximation at every real time, with uniform compact-path norm continuity. The ordinary fixed-time consequence holds at every original real datum outside literal physical L2 and every selected t>0, even relative to smooth data plus that point. Theorems 1.2 and 1.3 retain the full compatible family and weighted-target/asymptotic quantifiers. The local and compact global conclusions explicitly assert that the named continuous fourthScalarTrajectoryOn path is the unique smooth-approximation solution, closing the exported-statement gap identified in PR #1 review.

requirements.requirement: All essential mathematical dependencies are proved or imported from verified results, without proof holes or additional axioms.
requirements.detail: Fresh full transitive audits of all 1007 named declarations, including every main theorem, use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. All 219 focused source files are hash-checked and scanned for proof holes or axiom declarations. Physical PDE existence, uniqueness, arbitrary smooth-data realization, original distribution identification, frequency normalization, genuine smooth mass-phase approximants and fixed-time physical nonextension are established; no main mathematical obligation remains.
